HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.label: HR_Storyline_HR_Storyline_HRC001
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.startConditions: After the eastward-migration background, when a refugee household reaches the player settlement.
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.longTermConsequences: Settlement can add a household member, record the family's vessel and increase Zhou cultural presence. The last choice can end the chain as integrated or departed.
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.sourceNotes: Local characters, vessels, and choices are fictional gameplay; broad displacement and court migration are historical context.

HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.label: HR_Storyline_HR_Storyline_HRC002
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.startConditions: A farming settlement has land, grain, and a political community.
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.longTermConsequences: Food stock changes through choices; the community's political posture and relations with local authorities persist in HR-004.
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.sourceNotes: Fictional local disputes model long-term agrarian and political conditions; no local dispute is asserted as an attested event.

HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.label: HR_Storyline_HR_Storyline_HRC003
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.startConditions: A craftsperson arrives and the player has access to locally adopted bronze-casting technology.
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.longTermConsequences: Trading grain for copper and tin, paying material costs, and crafting a one-off bronze vessel changes actual inventory and records a unique relic.
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.sourceNotes: The named craftsperson and vessel are fictional. Bronze production is period context and does not imply universal access.

HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.label: HR_Storyline_HR_Storyline_HRC004
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.startConditions: A merchant reaches the settlement after the chronicle has executed the contested King Xie entry.
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.longTermConsequences: Repeated accounts and a resource choice can alter local posture and reveal only already-occurred history. The chronicle keeps occurrence and learned dates separate.
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.sourceNotes: Local messengers are fictional. Their incompatible accounts do not decide the historical chronology.

HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.label: HR_Storyline_HR_Storyline_HRC005
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.startConditions: A family enters through play in the Eastern Zhou scenario.
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.longTermConsequences: Birth and death milestones are observed, never scripted. Optional milestones expire into a family-continuation route. At the chapter end HR-010 exports a versioned family archive.
HistoricalRimWorld.Events.HistoricalStor.sourceNotes: All recorded births, relationships, deaths, and relic ownership come from this save; the chain never forces reproduction or death.
